audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said Skill/Lissandra at levels 1-3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items while the content-layer win[] and the packet levelChart said Irelia. The page rendered two different answers per row.
audit.why: Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s and refreshes on a Marked target or a killed minion, so Irelia gets repeat gap-closes into a Lissandra whose only lane answer is one 450-range W on a 10s cooldown. Level 6 is the genuine Lissandra row: Frozen Tomb is untargetable/invulnerable on self-cast and unmissable on target.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides realigned to the content layer and packet: Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Lissandra, Irelia, Irelia, with every why rewritten to match the verdict it sits under.

audit.why: Spikes are level 3-5 (Irelia's Q-reset plus Flawless Duet), level 6 (Frozen Tomb, 120/100/80s), first item (Malignance vs Irelia's first item plus Ionian Fervor stacks), and late. The four content spikes already state these correctly.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; phases[5].why and phases[6].why now name the first-item and late spikes from Irelia's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Bladesurge's reset condition, Flawless Duet's grounding (which denies your E claw return), and Bladesurge's heal (anti-heal timing).
audit.why: Flawless Duet carries grounding and hardCC flags — it stuns and shuts off your E return; Bladesurge carries dash and heal flags and refreshes on Marked targets; Vanguard's Edge creates terrain that blocks your claw path. Frozen Tomb's untargetable self-cast is your answer to her committed dash.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries real numbers (Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Bladesurge 10-6, your W 10s, E 24s at rank 1, R 120s), and the dos/donts bodies now explain the reset and the grounded claw instead of repeating tradeGood/tradeBad.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun and no named source of the sustain.
audit.why: The missing-interaction entry flags Bladesurge as the heal that decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal is now tied to Bladesurge's per-reset heal.
All lint-flagged pronouns fixed in the edits below.
